reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The meta_escape_buf static two-character array owns storage for a numeric -f escape byte and its NUL terminator.
owner_creation.invariant: The escape buffer owns exactly two static bytes.

aliases_escapes.analysis: meta_escape borrows meta_escape_buf's address after -f; printf and strlen only read through that pointer during the later output loop.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Escape-buffer aliases are read-only during emission.
limitations: Private single-invocation helper state only; metachars heap ownership and lstrtol arithmetic remain separate pending entries.

callback_targets.analysis: The meta_escape_buf array contains characters, not function pointers; consumers are direct libc string operations without retained callbacks.
callback_targets.invariant: Two-byte escape storage cannot register code.

invalidation.analysis: Repeated -f options overwrite the same static array before output; meta_escape_buf's address never changes and old values have no separate owner.
invalidation.invariant: Reusing the buffer does not invalidate its address.

mutation_commit.analysis: main_0 stores index zero, writes zero to index one, then points meta_escape to the meta_escape_buf buffer.
mutation_commit.invariant: The NUL terminator precedes pointer publication.

release_pair.analysis: meta_escape_buf has static lifetime and is never freed, including after meta_escape selects another literal or argv tail.
release_pair.invariant: Changing escape selection cannot release this array.

error_cleanup.analysis: A failed -f parse exits before output; meta_escape_buf writes remain within its two indices and acquire no allocation.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failed -f parsing cannot leave an allocated buffer.

signals_handoff.analysis: Only startup option parsing writes the meta_escape_buf array; the helper has no registered handler using it concurrently.
signals_handoff.invariant: No supported callback races the two-byte update.
